functions.name: wabt::ParseInt64
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::ParseInt64(const char* s, const char* end, uint64_t* out, wabt::ParseIntType parse_type);
functions.description: Parses an integer literal from [s, end) into a 64-bit integer. Returns Result::Ok on success; Result::Error on overflow or invalid input beyond lexer guarantees.
requirements: s and end must delimit a valid contiguous character range; s <= end.
out must be a valid, non-null pointer.
The literal should match wast-lexer integer patterns; only overflow is validated here.
Parsed value must fit in 64 bits; otherwise Result::Error is returned.
parse_type controls whether signed and/or unsigned forms are accepted.

functions.name: wabt::ParseUint64
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::ParseUint64(const char* s, const char* end, uint64_t* out);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned integer literal from [s, end) into a 64-bit unsigned integer. Returns Result::Ok on success; Result::Error on overflow or invalid input beyond lexer guarantees. Only unsigned forms are accepted.
requirements: s and end must delimit a valid contiguous character range; s <= end.
out must be a valid, non-null pointer.
The literal should match wast-lexer unsigned-integer patterns; only overflow is validated here.
Parsed value must fit in an unsigned 64-bit range; otherwise Result::Error is returned.

functions.name: wabt::ParseUint128
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::ParseUint128(const char* s, const char* end, wabt::v128* out);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned integer literal from [s, end) into a 128-bit value (stored in wabt::v128). Returns Result::Ok on success; Result::Error on overflow or invalid input beyond lexer guarantees. Only unsigned forms are accepted.
requirements: s and end must delimit a valid contiguous character range; s <= end.
out must be a valid, non-null pointer to a wabt::v128 storage.
The literal should match wast-lexer unsigned-integer patterns; only overflow is validated here.
Parsed value must fit within 128 bits; otherwise Result::Error is returned.

functions.name: wabt::ParseFloat
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::ParseFloat(wabt::LiteralType literal_type, const char* s, const char* end, uint32_t* out_bits);
functions.description: Parses a floating-point literal from [s, end) according to literal_type, producing IEEE-754 single-precision raw bits in out_bits. literal_type distinguishes between decimal float, hexadecimal float, infinity, and NaN forms. Returns Result::Ok on success; Result::Error on overflow or format issues beyond lexer guarantees. Only minimal validation is performed; input is assumed to have been pattern-matched by the wast-lexer.
requirements: s and end must delimit a valid contiguous character range; s <= end.
out_bits must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the 32-bit IEEE-754 representation.
literal_type must correctly describe the provided literal (e.g., Float, Hexfloat, Infinity, or Nan).
The literal should match wast-lexer floating patterns; this function primarily checks overflow/underflow and converts to bits.

functions.name: wabt::ParseDouble
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::ParseDouble(wabt::LiteralType literal_type, const char* s, const char* end, uint64_t* out_bits);
functions.description: Parses a floating-point literal from [s, end) according to literal_type, producing IEEE-754 double-precision raw bits in out_bits. literal_type distinguishes between decimal float, hexadecimal float, infinity, and NaN forms. Returns Result::Ok on success; Result::Error on overflow or format issues beyond lexer guarantees. Only minimal validation is performed; input is assumed to have been pattern-matched by the wast-lexer.
requirements: s and end must delimit a valid contiguous character range; s <= end.
out_bits must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the 64-bit IEEE-754 representation.
literal_type must correctly describe the provided literal (e.g., Float, Hexfloat, Infinity, or Nan).
The literal should match wast-lexer floating patterns; this function primarily checks overflow/underflow and converts to bits.

functions.name: wabt::WriteFloatHex
functions.signature: void wabt::WriteFloatHex(char* buffer, size_t size, uint32_t bits);
functions.description: Formats a 32-bit IEEE-754 value (provided as raw bits) into a hexadecimal float string and writes it into buffer. Intended to produce a canonical hex representation suitable for WABT tooling.
requirements: buffer must be a valid, writable memory block of at least size bytes.
size should be at least WABT_MAX_FLOAT_HEX (20) bytes to guarantee the entire output fits, including the null terminator if one is written.
bits must contain a valid IEEE-754 single-precision representation.

functions.name: wabt::WriteDoubleHex
functions.signature: void wabt::WriteDoubleHex(char* buffer, size_t size, uint64_t bits);
functions.description: Formats a 64-bit IEEE-754 value (provided as raw bits) into a hexadecimal float string and writes it into buffer. Intended to produce a canonical hex representation suitable for WABT tooling.
requirements: buffer must be a valid, writable memory block of at least size bytes.
size should be at least WABT_MAX_DOUBLE_HEX (40) bytes to guarantee the entire output fits, including the null terminator if one is written.
bits must contain a valid IEEE-754 double-precision representation.

functions.name: wabt::WriteUint128
functions.signature: void wabt::WriteUint128(char* buffer, size_t size, wabt::v128 bits);
functions.description: Formats a 128-bit unsigned integer value (stored in wabt::v128) into a textual representation and writes it into buffer. The exact base/format is not specified in this header; presumed to be a canonical representation used by WABT.
requirements: buffer must be a valid, writable memory block of at least size bytes.
size must be large enough to hold the full textual representation plus terminator; the required minimum is not specified in this header (unknown).
bits provides the 128-bit value to format.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::FromCode
functions.description: Constructs an Opcode from a raw opcode byte value (no prefix). Uses an internal lookup table to translate the numeric code into an Opcode enum; if the code is not recognized, returns an Opcode marked as invalid. Intended for decoding Wasm opcodes from binary streams that do not use a prefix.
requirements: code may be any 32-bit value; unrecognized values will yield an invalid Opcode (IsInvalid() == true)
Callers should be prepared to handle invalid opcodes (e.g., by checking IsInvalid()).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::HasPrefix
functions.description: Returns true if this opcode belongs to a prefixed opcode space (its prefix field is nonzero).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetPrefix
functions.description: Returns the opcode’s prefix byte if any, or 0 for non-prefixed opcodes.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetCode
functions.description: Returns the opcode’s numeric code (excluding any prefix).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetLength
functions.description: Returns the length in bytes of this opcode’s encoding, including any prefix byte(s). Equivalent to GetBytes().size().

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetName
functions.description: Returns the canonical mnemonic name string for this opcode.
requirements: The returned C string is owned by the library; callers must not modify or free it.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetDecomp
functions.description: Returns the decompilation-friendly name for this opcode if available; otherwise returns the canonical name. Useful for textual/disassembled output.
requirements: The returned C string is owned by the library; callers must not modify or free it.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetResultType
functions.description: Returns the result value type produced by this opcode (or a sentinel for no result, depending on Type).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetParamType1
functions.description: Returns the first parameter type consumed by this opcode.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetParamType2
functions.description: Returns the second parameter type consumed by this opcode.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetParamType3
functions.description: Returns the third parameter type consumed by this opcode.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetParamType
functions.description: Returns the nth parameter type consumed by this opcode, where n is 1-based (n=1..3).
requirements: n must be in the range 1..3; other values will index out of bounds and are invalid.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetMemorySize
functions.description: Returns the natural memory access size associated with this opcode (for memory ops). For non-memory ops, this may be zero or an internal sentinel (details not specified in this header).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetBytes
functions.description: Returns the byte sequence for this opcode’s encoding, including any prefix byte.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetSimdLaneCount
functions.description: Returns the lane count for SIMD extract/replace operations. For non-applicable opcodes, behavior is not specified in this header (may be zero or undefined).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::IsNaturallyAligned
functions.description: Returns true if the provided alignment matches the opcode’s natural alignment, or if the provided alignment equals WABT_USE_NATURAL_ALIGNMENT (a special sentinel meaning “use natural alignment”).
requirements: alignment may be any Address value; passing WABT_USE_NATURAL_ALIGNMENT requests checking against the opcode’s natural alignment.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::GetAlignment
functions.description: Returns the effective alignment: if the provided alignment equals WABT_USE_NATURAL_ALIGNMENT, returns this opcode’s natural alignment; otherwise returns the provided alignment value unchanged.
requirements: alignment may be any Address value; WABT_USE_NATURAL_ALIGNMENT is treated specially as “use natural alignment”.
Callers should ensure alignment values are appropriate for the target memory operation to avoid misaligned accesses (not enforced here).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::IsPrefixByte
functions.description: Returns true if the given byte is a known opcode prefix (math, threads, or SIMD).

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::IsEnabled
functions.description: Returns true if this opcode is enabled under the provided feature set (e.g., SIMD, threads). Use to gate decoding/validation based on configured WebAssembly features.
requirements: features must be a valid, initialized wabt::Features instance configured with the desired feature flags.

functions.name: wabt::Opcode::IsInvalid
functions.description: Returns true if this Opcode instance represents an invalid/unknown opcode value (i.e., not a recognized enum).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::Option::Option
functions.signature: wabt::OptionParser::Option::Option(char short_name, const std::string& long_name, const std::string& metavar, wabt::OptionParser::HasArgument has_argument, const std::string& help, const wabt::OptionParser::Callback& callback)
functions.description: Constructs a single command-line option descriptor to be used with OptionParser. It defines short/long names, whether it takes an argument, the metavar used in help text, help string, and the callback invoked when the option is encountered. Typical usage: create Option objects and register them via OptionParser::AddOption.
requirements: short_name may be '\0' if no short option is desired (inferred from common patterns; not explicitly stated).
long_name should be a non-empty long option name without leading dashes (inferred from common CLI conventions).
If has_argument is HasArgument::Yes, the provided callback must accept a non-null const char* argument value (by type).
Callback must be callable as void(const char*).
help and metavar are for display; no functional requirement stated.

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::Argument::Argument
functions.signature: wabt::OptionParser::Argument::Argument(const std::string& name, wabt::OptionParser::ArgumentCount count, const wabt::OptionParser::Callback& callback)
functions.description: Constructs a positional argument descriptor for OptionParser, defining the argument name, how many occurrences/values are accepted (one, one-or-more, or zero-or-more), and the callback invoked for each handled argument.
requirements: name is a display label for help; no functional constraint stated.
count must be one of: ArgumentCount::One, ArgumentCount::OneOrMore, or ArgumentCount::ZeroOrMore.
callback must be callable as void(const char*).
handled_count is maintained internally; callers should not depend on it.

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::OptionParser
functions.signature: wabt::OptionParser::OptionParser(const char* program_name, const char* description)
functions.description: Creates an option parser instance with program name and a short description used in help output. After construction, options and positional arguments can be added, then Parse() is called to process argv.
requirements: program_name should point to a valid, null-terminated C string (inferred from const char*).
description should point to a valid, null-terminated C string (inferred from const char*).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::AddOption
functions.description: Registers a fully-constructed Option with the parser so it can be recognized during parsing.
requirements: option must have been constructed with a valid callback matching whether it expects an argument (inferred from types).
long and/or short names in option should be unique among all added options to avoid ambiguity (inferred from common parser behavior).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::AddOption
functions.signature: void wabt::OptionParser::AddOption(char short_name, const char* long_name, const char* help, const wabt::OptionParser::NullCallback& callback)
functions.description: Convenience overload to register a flag-style option that takes no argument. Associates short/long names and help text with a null-argument callback invoked when the option is present.
requirements: callback must be callable as void().
long_name should be a valid C string without leading dashes (inferred).
help should be a valid C string (inferred).
short_name may be '\0' if no short option is desired (inferred).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::AddOption
functions.signature: void wabt::OptionParser::AddOption(const char* long_name, const char* help, const wabt::OptionParser::NullCallback& callback)
functions.description: Convenience overload to register a long-name-only flag-style option that takes no argument. The null-argument callback is invoked when the option is present.
requirements: callback must be callable as void().
long_name should be a valid C string without leading dashes (inferred).
help should be a valid C string (inferred).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::AddOption
functions.signature: void wabt::OptionParser::AddOption(char short_name, const char* long_name, const char* metavar, const char* help, const wabt::OptionParser::Callback& callback)
functions.description: Convenience overload to register an option that requires an argument. Defines short/long names, a metavar for help display, help text, and a callback that receives the option's argument value.
requirements: callback must be callable as void(const char*).
If provided, metavar and help should be valid C strings (inferred).
long_name should be a valid C string without leading dashes (inferred).
When this option is present during parsing, an argument value is expected and will be passed to the callback.

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::AddArgument
functions.signature: void wabt::OptionParser::AddArgument(const std::string& name, wabt::OptionParser::ArgumentCount count, const wabt::OptionParser::Callback& callback)
functions.description: Registers a positional argument specification with the parser, providing its display name, the allowed multiplicity, and the callback to invoke for each consumed positional value.
requirements: count must be one of: ArgumentCount::One, ArgumentCount::OneOrMore, or ArgumentCount::ZeroOrMore.
callback must be callable as void(const char*).
Order of added positional arguments determines parsing order (inferred from common parsers).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::SetErrorCallback
functions.description: Sets a custom error callback invoked on parse errors. Overrides the default behavior (DefaultError), which prints the error and exits(1). The callback receives the error message as a C string.
requirements: callback must be callable as void(const char*).

If no error callback is set, the parser may print an error and terminate the process (per DefaultError comment). Ensure custom callback is set before calling Parse() if you need to intercept errors (inferred).

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::Parse
functions.description: Parses command-line options and positional arguments from the conventional argc/argv pair, invoking registered callbacks for each recognized option or argument. On errors, invokes the configured error handling (custom callback if set, otherwise default).
requirements: argc should be non-negative and reflect the number of entries in argv (inferred from C/C++ conventions).
argv must be a valid array of pointers to null-terminated strings, with at least argc elements (inferred).
Options and arguments should be added before calling Parse().
Callbacks registered for options/arguments must be robust to being called multiple times depending on input.

functions.name: wabt::OptionParser::PrintHelp
functions.description: Prints usage information, including program name, description, options, and positional arguments. Intended to be called to display help output, typically for --help or on errors.

functions.name: wabt::ResolveNamesModule
functions.description: Resolves identifier names within a WebAssembly Module, mapping textual names to their internal indices and collecting any resolution diagnostics. Typical usage is immediately after parsing and before later validation or translation steps. Returns a wabt::Result indicating success or failure; on failure, details are reported via the provided Errors sink if non-null. Specific resolution rules are not documented here and remain unknown from this header.
requirements: The wabt::Module* argument must be a valid, initialized Module object (non-null).
If an wabt::Errors* is provided, it must point to a valid error collection object capable of receiving diagnostics (non-null if used).
Callers must check the returned wabt::Result and handle failure appropriately (e.g., do not proceed to later stages on failure).
Behavior when passing a null wabt::Errors* is not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: wabt::ResolveNamesScript
functions.description: Resolves identifier names across a WebAssembly Script (potentially containing multiple modules and commands), mapping textual names to internal references and collecting any resolution diagnostics. Intended to be called after parsing the Script and prior to validation or execution. Returns a wabt::Result; errors are reported through the Errors sink if supplied. Specific script resolution semantics are not detailed in this header and remain unknown.
requirements: The wabt::Script* argument must be a valid, initialized Script object (non-null).
If an wabt::Errors* is provided, it must be a valid pointer to a diagnostics collection (non-null if used).
Callers must inspect the returned wabt::Result and handle failures appropriately.
Behavior when passing a null wabt::Errors* is not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: wabt::sha256
functions.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of the given input and writes the result into the provided digest string. Intended for callers that already have data in memory as a string-like view and want the corresponding SHA-256 digest as a string. Notes: The header does not specify whether the output digest is hex-encoded text or raw binary bytes, nor whether the function clears or appends to the output string—these details are unknown from this declaration.
requirements: digest must be a valid, mutable std::string lvalue; it will be modified by the function.
input must be a valid std::string_view referencing accessible memory for the duration of the call.
No return value is provided; callers must read the digest out-parameter for results.

The exact encoding/format of the output (hex vs. binary) and whether digest is cleared or appended is not specified in this header; callers should not assume a particular format without consulting the implementation or higher-level docs.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::SharedValidator
functions.description: Constructs a SharedValidator used to validate a WebAssembly module/sequence using the provided options. The Errors pointer is used to collect/emit validation diagnostics. Typical usage: create ValidateOptions (optionally with Features), construct SharedValidator, then feed module/type/instruction events to it.
requirements: errors must be a valid (non-null) pointer if you expect diagnostics to be recorded; passing null may disable error recording or cause undefined behavior (implementation-specific, not stated).
The passed ValidateOptions must remain valid during construction; no further lifetime requirements are stated.
Callers are expected to drive validation by invoking the corresponding On* methods in a correct order for a wasm module.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::type_stack_size
functions.description: Returns the current size of the internal type stack used by the validator/type checker while validating expressions/blocks.
requirements: May be called only after the validator has been constructed; no other preconditions are documented.
Result reflects internal state; use only for introspection/logging.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::GetLabel
functions.description: Retrieves a control label at the given depth from the type checker’s control stack. Useful for validating branch targets.
requirements: out_label must be a non-null pointer to receive the Label* result.
depth is a 0-based depth into the active label stack; must refer to an existing label.
Check the returned Result and do not use out_label on failure.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::GetCatchCount
functions.description: Returns the number of catch handlers associated with the try/catch construct at the given control depth.
requirements: out_count must be a non-null pointer to receive the count.
depth must refer to a valid label/control construct that supports catch handlers.
Check and handle the returned Result before using out_count.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::PrintError
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::PrintError(const wabt::Location& loc, const char* fmt, ...)
functions.description: Formats and records an error message associated with the given source/binary location. Acts like printf with variadic arguments and WABT_PRINTF_FORMAT annotations.
requirements: fmt must be a valid printf-style format string matching the provided variadic arguments.
loc should denote a valid location (offset) if available; unknown locations are allowed.
The caller must pass arguments consistent with fmt; mismatches are undefined behavior.
Check the returned Result to see if recording the error succeeded.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTypecheckerError
functions.description: Callback invoked when the internal type checker reports an error; forwards or records the message.
requirements: msg must be a non-null, null-terminated string describing the error.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::GetLocalCount
functions.description: Returns the number of locals (including parameters) tracked for the current function being validated. Intended for validating local.* instructions.
requirements: Must be called within a function body context to return meaningful data; otherwise the value may be zero.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::EndModule
functions.description: Signals the end of module validation, allowing the validator to perform final consistency checks (e.g., exports, start function, segments).
requirements: Should be called after all module sections and items have been reported via On* methods.
Caller must check and handle the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnFuncType
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnFuncType(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Index param_count, const wabt::Type* param_types, wabt::Index result_count, const wabt::Type* result_types, wabt::Index type_index)
functions.description: Declares or validates a function type (type section entry) with the given parameter and result types at the provided type index.
requirements: param_types must point to an array of length param_count when param_count > 0; may be null when param_count == 0.
result_types must point to an array of length result_count when result_count > 0; may be null when result_count == 0.
type_index must be the index where this type is being defined/recorded.
Caller must provide a valid Location for diagnostics and check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnStructType
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnStructType(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Index field_count, wabt::TypeMut* fields)
functions.description: Declares or validates a struct type with the given number of fields and their mutability/types.
requirements: fields must point to an array of length field_count when field_count > 0; may be null when field_count == 0.
Caller must ensure field definitions are complete (type and mutability).
Check and handle the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnArrayType
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnArrayType(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::TypeMut field)
functions.description: Declares or validates an array type with a single element field (type and mutability).
requirements: field must describe a valid element type and mutability.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnFunction
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnFunction(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var sig_var)
functions.description: Declares or begins validation of a function that references an existing function type by var (index or name).
requirements: sig_var must reference a previously defined function type.
Caller must provide a valid Location for diagnostics and check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTable
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTable(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type elem_type, const wabt::Limits& limits, wabt::TableImportStatus import_status, wabt::TableInitExprStatus init_provided)
functions.description: Declares or validates a table with the given element reference type, limits, and import/initialization status.
requirements: limits must represent valid min/max per module rules; element type must be a valid reference type.
import_status and init_provided must match the table's origin and presence of initializer expression.
Check the returned Result for validation success.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemory
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemory(const wabt::Location& loc, const wabt::Limits& limits, uint32_t page_size)
functions.description: Declares or validates a linear memory with the given limits and page size.
requirements: limits must comply with memory constraints (min ≤ max when present; absolute maxima apply per features; exact rules not specified in header).
page_size must be a valid page size used by the environment (typically 64 KiB; exact requirement unknown).
Check and handle the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalImport
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalImport(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type type, bool mutable_)
functions.description: Declares or validates an imported global with the given value type and mutability.
requirements: type must be a valid value type; mutability indicates if the global is mutable.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobal
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobal(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type type, bool mutable_)
functions.description: Declares or validates a defined global with the given value type and mutability; the initializer is subsequently validated via init expr callbacks.
requirements: type must be a valid value type; mutability indicates if the global is mutable.
Must be followed by a valid initializer expression sequence (BeginInitExpr/EndInitExpr) when defining.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTag
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTag(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var sig_var)
functions.description: Declares or validates an exception tag (event) that references a function type describing the tag’s parameter types.
requirements: sig_var must reference an existing function type describing the tag’s params.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnExport
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnExport(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::ExternalKind kind, wabt::Var item_var, std::string_view name)
functions.description: Validates an export entry, ensuring the referenced item of the given kind exists and that the export name is valid/non-duplicate.
requirements: kind must correctly reflect the target (func/table/memory/global/tag).
item_var must reference an existing item of the specified kind.
name must be a valid export name; duplicates are rejected.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnStart
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnStart(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var func_var)
functions.description: Validates the start function declaration, ensuring the function exists and has the correct type (no params, no results).
requirements: func_var must reference an existing function of type [] -> [].
Only one start function may be declared per module.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnElemSegment
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnElemSegment(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var, wabt::SegmentKind kind)
functions.description: Begins validation of an element segment associated with a table (active/passive/declared kind).
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table when kind requires a table (active).
kind must correctly represent the segment’s mode.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnElemSegmentElemType
functions.description: Specifies or validates the element type of the current element segment (e.g., funcref or externref).
requirements: elem_type must be a valid reference type for the target table.
Must be called in the context of an element segment being validated.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnDataCount
functions.description: Records the declared number of data segments for use in validating data count and memory.init/drop instructions.
requirements: count is the number of data segments that will be declared; must match the actual number later for consistency.
Call before individual data segments if using data count section.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnDataSegment
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnDataSegment(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var memory_var, wabt::SegmentKind kind)
functions.description: Begins validation of a data segment associated with a memory (active/passive kind).
requirements: memory_var must reference an existing memory when the segment is active.
kind must correctly represent the segment’s mode.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::BeginInitExpr
functions.description: Marks the beginning of an initializer expression for a global, table, element, or data context, with an expected resulting type.
requirements: type is the expected resulting type of the init expression and must match the target’s type.
Must be paired with a corresponding EndInitExpr.
Only constant-allowed opcodes may appear within an init expr; exact set not specified here.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::EndInitExpr
functions.description: Ends the current initializer expression, checking stack/result type compliance.
requirements: Must be preceded by a successful BeginInitExpr.
Caller must check the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::BeginFunctionBody
functions.description: Begins validation of a function body by function index, preparing local type information and the type checker.
requirements: func_index must reference a declared function with an associated type.
Must be paired with EndFunctionBody after all body instructions are validated.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::EndFunctionBody
functions.description: Ends validation of the current function body, verifying block closure and result types.
requirements: Must be preceded by a successful BeginFunctionBody for the same function.
All blocks must be properly closed before calling this function.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalDecl
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalDecl(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Index count, wabt::Type type)
functions.description: Declares a run-length encoded sequence of local variables of the given type within the current function body.
requirements: Must be called after BeginFunctionBody and before any instructions that rely on locals being available.
count is the number of locals to add; when count > 0, type must be a valid value type.
Caller must check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicFence
functions.description: Validates an atomic fence instruction with the given memory consistency model value.
requirements: consistency_model must be a valid encoding for the targeted feature set; exact values not specified here.
Must be used within a function body.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicLoad
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicLoad(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic load instruction with the provided opcode, memory index, alignment, and offset.
requirements: opcode must be an atomic load opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align must satisfy the natural alignment for the opcode; exact rule not specified here.
offset must be within memory limits; exact checking deferred to validator.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicNotify
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicNotify(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic notify instruction (wake) for the given memory, alignment, and offset.
requirements: opcode must be the appropriate atomic notify opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align and offset must be valid for the operation.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicRmwCmpxchg
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicRmwCmpxchg(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic read-modify-write compare-exchange instruction.
requirements: opcode must be an atomic cmpxchg opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align must meet opcode requirements; offset must be valid.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicRmw
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicRmw(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic read-modify-write instruction (e.g., add, sub, and, or).
requirements: opcode must be an atomic RMW opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align and offset must be valid for the opcode.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicStore
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicStore(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic store instruction.
requirements: opcode must be an atomic store opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align and offset must be valid for the opcode.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicWait
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnAtomicWait(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates an atomic wait instruction for 32-bit or 64-bit wait, depending on opcode.
requirements: opcode must be an atomic wait opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align and offset must be valid for the opcode.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBinary
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnBinary(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode)
functions.description: Validates a binary numeric or vector operation indicated by opcode (e.g., i32.add).
requirements: opcode must be a valid binary opcode for the current features.
Must be called within a function body and correct operand types must be on the stack (enforced by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBlock
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnBlock(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type sig_type)
functions.description: Begins validation of a block construct with the given block signature type (param/result encoded as Type).
requirements: sig_type must represent a valid block type/signature.
Must be balanced with OnEnd or control-structure closures.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBr
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnBr(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var depth)
functions.description: Validates an unconditional branch to the label at the specified depth.
requirements: depth must refer to an active label in the control stack.
Stack values must match the target label’s expected arity/type (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrIf
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrIf(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var depth)
functions.description: Validates a conditional branch to the label at the specified depth.
requirements: depth must refer to an active label.
A condition value must be provided on the stack; types must match label expectations.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrOnNonNull
functions.description: Validates a branch-on-non-null reference to the label at the given depth (reference types).
requirements: depth must refer to an active label.
Top of stack must be a reference type; branching occurs when it is non-null (semantics checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrOnNull
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrOnNull(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var depth)
functions.description: Validates a branch-on-null reference to the label at the given depth.
requirements: depth must refer to an active label.
Top of stack must be a reference type; branching occurs on null (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::BeginBrTable
functions.description: Begins validation of a br_table instruction sequence, preparing to receive targets via OnBrTableTarget and then EndBrTable.
requirements: Must be followed by one or more OnBrTableTarget calls and a final EndBrTable.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnBrTableTarget
functions.description: Adds a branch target depth for the current br_table under validation.
requirements: Must be called after BeginBrTable and before EndBrTable.
depth must refer to an active label.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::EndBrTable
functions.description: Ends validation of a br_table instruction, finalizing checks for target types/arity consistency.
requirements: Must be preceded by BeginBrTable and one or more OnBrTableTarget calls.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnCall
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnCall(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var func_var)
functions.description: Validates a direct call to a function by var (index or name).
requirements: func_var must reference an existing function.
Operand stack must supply arguments matching the function type; results are produced accordingly (enforced by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnCallIndirect
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnCallIndirect(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var sig_var, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates an indirect call via a table, referencing a function type and table variable.
requirements: sig_var must reference an existing function type.
table_var must reference an existing table with a compatible element type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnCallRef
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnCallRef(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var function_type_var)
functions.description: Validates a call_ref instruction, calling a function value with the given expected function type.
requirements: function_type_var must reference an existing function type.
Top-of-stack function reference must be non-null and of the referenced type (enforced by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnCatch
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnCatch(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var tag_var, bool is_catch_all)
functions.description: Validates a catch or catch_all clause within a try/try_table construct.
requirements: Must be within the scope of a try construct.
If is_catch_all is false, tag_var must reference an existing tag; for catch_all, tag_var is ignored.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnCompare
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnCompare(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode)
functions.description: Validates a comparison operation (e.g., i32.eq, f64.lt) based on the opcode.
requirements: opcode must be a valid comparison opcode.
Correct operand types must be on the stack (enforced by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnConst
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnConst(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type type)
functions.description: Begins validation for a constant literal of the given type; actual literal value is supplied via the surrounding reader callbacks.
requirements: type must be a valid numeric/reference/vector type that matches the literal being parsed.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnConvert
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnConvert(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode)
functions.description: Validates a numeric conversion/reinterpret/extend instruction indicated by opcode.
requirements: opcode must be a valid conversion opcode.
Stack operand types must be compatible (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnDataDrop
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnDataDrop(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var segment_var)
functions.description: Validates a data.drop instruction for the referenced data segment.
requirements: segment_var must reference an existing data segment.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnDelegate
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnDelegate(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var depth)
functions.description: Validates a delegate instruction that forwards exception handling to an outer handler at the given depth.
requirements: depth must reference a valid enclosing try handler target.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnDrop
functions.description: Validates a drop instruction consuming the top stack value.
requirements: Must be in a function body with at least one value on the stack at that point.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnElemDrop
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnElemDrop(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var segment_var)
functions.description: Validates an elem.drop instruction for the referenced element segment.
requirements: segment_var must reference an existing element segment.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnElse
functions.description: Validates an else clause transition in an if/else construct.
requirements: Must be within a currently open if construct that permits an else.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnEnd
functions.description: Validates an end opcode closing the current block/if/loop/try scope.
requirements: There must be an open control scope to close.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalGet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalGet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var var)
functions.description: Validates a global.get instruction for the referenced global.
requirements: var must reference an existing global.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalSet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnGlobalSet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var var)
functions.description: Validates a global.set instruction for a mutable referenced global.
requirements: var must reference an existing mutable global of the appropriate type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnIf
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnIf(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type sig_type)
functions.description: Begins validation of an if construct with the given block signature type.
requirements: sig_type must represent a valid block type/signature.
A condition value must be on the stack prior to the if (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoad
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoad(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates a memory load instruction with the given opcode, memory index, alignment, and offset.
requirements: opcode must be a valid load opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory.
align must be valid for the opcode’s access width; offset must be within memory limits.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoadSplat
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoadSplat(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD load-splat instruction.
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD load-splat opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory; align and offset must be valid.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoadZero
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoadZero(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD load-zero instruction.
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD load-zero opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory; align and offset must be valid.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalGet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalGet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var var)
functions.description: Validates a local.get instruction for the referenced local index.
requirements: var must reference an existing local (including parameters).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalSet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalSet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var var)
functions.description: Validates a local.set instruction for the referenced local index.
requirements: var must reference an existing local; top-of-stack value must match local type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalTee
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLocalTee(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var var)
functions.description: Validates a local.tee instruction which writes to a local and retains the value on the stack.
requirements: var must reference an existing local; value type must match the local type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoop
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnLoop(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type sig_type)
functions.description: Begins validation of a loop construct with the given signature type.
requirements: sig_type must be a valid block type/signature for the loop.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryCopy
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryCopy(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var destmemidx, wabt::Var srcmemidx)
functions.description: Validates a memory.copy instruction between source and destination memories (possibly the same).
requirements: destmemidx and srcmemidx must reference existing memories.
Feature support for multiple memories may be required; exact rules not specified here.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryFill
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryFill(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var memidx)
functions.description: Validates a memory.fill instruction for the referenced memory.
requirements: memidx must reference an existing memory.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryGrow
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryGrow(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var memidx)
functions.description: Validates a memory.grow instruction for the referenced memory.
requirements: memidx must reference an existing memory.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryInit
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemoryInit(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var segment_var, wabt::Var memidx)
functions.description: Validates a memory.init instruction using the given data segment and memory indices.
requirements: segment_var must reference an existing data segment; memidx must reference an existing memory.
Requires that data count (if present) be consistent.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemorySize
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnMemorySize(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var memidx)
functions.description: Validates a memory.size instruction for the referenced memory.
requirements: memidx must reference an existing memory.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnNop
functions.description: Validates a nop instruction (no operation).
requirements: Must be within a function body.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefAsNonNull
functions.description: Validates a ref.as_non_null instruction which traps on null references.
requirements: Top-of-stack must be a nullable reference type; produces a non-nullable reference (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefFunc
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefFunc(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var func_var)
functions.description: Validates a ref.func instruction referencing a function, producing a funcref to that function.
requirements: func_var must reference an existing function.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefIsNull
functions.description: Validates a ref.is_null instruction that tests whether a reference is null.
requirements: Top-of-stack must be a reference type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefNull
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnRefNull(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var func_type_var)
functions.description: Validates a ref.null instruction producing a null reference of the specified function type or reference heap type.
requirements: func_type_var must reference a function type or heap type descriptor appropriate for the null reference being produced.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnRethrow
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnRethrow(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var depth)
functions.description: Validates a rethrow instruction that propagates an active exception to an outer handler at the given depth.
requirements: Must be executed within a catch scope with an active exception.
depth must reference a valid enclosing handler.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturnCall
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturnCall(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var func_var)
functions.description: Validates a return_call instruction to the specified function, combining call with an immediate return.
requirements: func_var must reference an existing function.
Argument types must match the callee’s type (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturnCallIndirect
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturnCallIndirect(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var sig_var, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a return_call_indirect instruction through a table with the specified function type.
requirements: sig_var must reference an existing function type.
table_var must reference an existing table with compatible element type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturnCallRef
functions.description: Validates a return_call_ref instruction that calls a function reference and returns.
requirements: function_type_var must reference an existing function type.
Top-of-stack must be a function reference matching the type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnReturn
functions.description: Validates a return instruction for the current function, ensuring result arity/types match the declared signature.
requirements: Must be within a function body.
Stack must contain values matching the function’s result types.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnSelect
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnSelect(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Index result_count, wabt::Type* result_types)
functions.description: Validates a typed select instruction (or legacy untyped when result_count==0) using the provided result type annotations.
requirements: If result_count > 0, result_types must point to an array of that length specifying the result type(s).
Stack must provide two candidate values and a condition; types must be compatible.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdLaneOp
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdLaneOp(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, uint64_t lane_idx)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD lane operation with the given lane index (e.g., extract_lane, replace_lane).
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD lane opcode.
lane_idx must be within the lane count for the opcode’s vector type.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdLoadLane
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdLoadLane(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset, uint64_t lane_idx)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD load_lane instruction operating on a specific lane.
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD load_lane opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory; align/offset must be valid.
lane_idx must be within the valid lane range.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdStoreLane
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdStoreLane(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset, uint64_t lane_idx)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD store_lane instruction for a specific lane.
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD store_lane opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory; align/offset must be valid.
lane_idx must be within the valid lane range.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdShuffleOp
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnSimdShuffleOp(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::v128 lane_idx)
functions.description: Validates a SIMD shuffle instruction using the provided 16-byte lane index mask.
requirements: opcode must be a valid SIMD shuffle opcode.
lane_idx must encode a valid 16-lane shuffle mask.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnStore
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnStore(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode, wabt::Var memidx, wabt::Address align, wabt::Address offset)
functions.description: Validates a memory store instruction with the given opcode, memory index, alignment, and offset.
requirements: opcode must be a valid store opcode.
memidx must reference an existing memory; align and offset must be valid for the store width.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableCopy
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableCopy(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var dst_var, wabt::Var src_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.copy instruction from src table to dst table (possibly the same).
requirements: dst_var and src_var must reference existing tables with compatible element types.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableFill
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableFill(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.fill instruction for the referenced table.
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table.
Value and count types must match table element type (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableGet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableGet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.get instruction for the referenced table.
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table.
Index type must be i32 (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableGrow
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableGrow(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.grow instruction for the referenced table.
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table.
Value type must match table element type; delta count must be i32 (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableInit
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableInit(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var segment_var, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.init instruction initializing a table from an element segment.
requirements: segment_var must reference an existing element segment; table_var must reference an existing table.
Element types must be compatible.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableSet
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableSet(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.set instruction for the referenced table.
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table.
Value type must match table element type; index must be i32 (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableSize
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTableSize(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var table_var)
functions.description: Validates a table.size instruction for the referenced table.
requirements: table_var must reference an existing table.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTernary
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTernary(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode)
functions.description: Validates a ternary instruction (an opcode that consumes three operands), typically SIMD or saturating operations that require three inputs.
requirements: opcode must be a valid ternary opcode for the active features.
Operand stack must satisfy the opcode’s type requirements.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnThrow
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnThrow(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Var tag_var)
functions.description: Validates a throw instruction that throws an exception described by the given tag.
requirements: tag_var must reference an existing tag; provided operands must match the tag’s parameter types (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnThrowRef
functions.description: Validates a throw_ref instruction which throws an exception reference value from the stack.
requirements: Top-of-stack must be an exception reference as required by the feature set (checked by validator).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTry
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTry(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type sig_type)
functions.description: Begins validation of a try construct with the given block signature type.
requirements: sig_type must be a valid block signature.
Must be closed by catch/catch_all and end/delegate appropriately.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::BeginTryTable
functions.description: Begins validation of a try_table construct with the given signature, preparing to receive catch table entries.
requirements: sig_type must be a valid block signature.
Must be followed by one or more OnTryTableCatch calls and EndTryTable.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnTryTableCatch
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnTryTableCatch(const wabt::Location& loc, const wabt::TableCatch& entry)
functions.description: Adds a catch entry to the current try_table under validation.
requirements: Must be called after BeginTryTable and before EndTryTable.
entry must describe a valid catch (tag or catch_all as allowed).
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::EndTryTable
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::EndTryTable(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Type sig_type)
functions.description: Ends validation of a try_table construct, finalizing type and control-flow checks.
requirements: Must be preceded by BeginTryTable and zero or more OnTryTableCatch calls.
sig_type must match the begin signature for consistency.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnUnary
functions.signature: wabt::Result wabt::SharedValidator::OnUnary(const wabt::Location& loc, wabt::Opcode opcode)
functions.description: Validates a unary numeric or vector operation indicated by opcode (e.g., i32.clz).
requirements: opcode must be a valid unary opcode.
Operand type on the stack must match the opcode’s requirements.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::SharedValidator::OnUnreachable
functions.description: Validates an unreachable instruction, marking the following code path as unreachable in the type checker.
requirements: Must be in a function body.
Check the Result.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::Stream
functions.description: Constructs a Stream, optionally attaching a log stream to mirror/log all write operations. The base Stream maintains an internal byte offset and a cumulative Result status.
requirements: If a non-null log stream is passed, it must outlive this Stream instance.
The provided log_stream, if non-null, must be a valid wabt::Stream pointer.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::~Stream
functions.description: Virtual destructor for Stream. Cleans up derived resources via virtual dispatch as needed.
requirements: The Stream must not be used after destruction.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::offset
functions.description: Returns the current write offset within the stream.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::result
functions.description: Returns the cumulative Result of prior stream operations (implementation-defined in wabt/common.h).

functions.name: wabt::Stream::set_log_stream
functions.description: Sets the log stream to which all writes will also be logged.
requirements: Argument stream must be non-null (asserted).
The provided stream must remain valid for as long as this Stream may log to it.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::log_stream
functions.description: Returns a reference to the currently configured log stream.
requirements: A log stream must have been set (has_log_stream() must be true); otherwise this function asserts.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::has_log_stream
functions.description: Indicates whether a log stream is currently attached.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::ClearOffset
functions.description: Resets the current stream write offset to 0.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::AddOffset
functions.description: Adjusts the current write offset by the signed delta (positive or negative).
requirements: Resulting offset must be representable as size_t and not underflow/overflow internal bounds (behavior/enforcement is implementation-defined).

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteData
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteData(const void* src, size_t size, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes raw bytes from src to the stream at the current offset, optionally logging a description and optionally printing ASCII characters when logging/debugging.
requirements: src must point to at least size readable bytes (unless size == 0).
The stream must be in a writable state; failures are reflected in the returned cumulative Result (via result()).
If a log stream is attached, it must remain valid during the call.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteDataAt
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteDataAt(size_t offset, const void* src, size_t size, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes raw bytes from src into the stream at the specified absolute offset, without affecting the current offset, optionally with description/logging.
requirements: src must point to at least size readable bytes (unless size == 0).
offset + size must fit within the stream’s addressable range as supported by the underlying implementation.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::MoveData
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::MoveData(size_t dst_offset, size_t src_offset, size_t size)
functions.description: Moves a block of data within the stream from src_offset to dst_offset for size bytes. Delegates to the implementation in derived classes.
requirements: dst_offset + size and src_offset + size must be valid ranges within the stream’s storage.
Behavior for overlapping ranges is defined by the underlying implementation (not specified here).

functions.name: wabt::Stream::Truncate
functions.description: Truncates (or extends) the stream to the given size, as supported by the derived implementation.
requirements: The implementation must support truncation/extension semantics; otherwise result() may reflect an error.
If truncating below current offset, callers should be aware that subsequent writes may occur beyond end unless offset is adjusted.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::Writef
functions.description: Formats data using a printf-style format string and writes the result to the stream at the current offset. May also log to an attached log stream.
requirements: format must be a valid printf-style format string.
The variadic arguments must match the format specifiers to avoid undefined behavior.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteU8
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteU8(uint32_t value, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned value to the stream. Asserts that the input fits in a byte.
requirements: value must be <= 255 (asserted).

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteU32
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteU32(uint32_t value, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned value to the stream.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteU64
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteU64(uint64_t value, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned value to the stream.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteU128
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteU128(v128 value, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes a 128-bit SIMD value (v128) to the stream. Endianness is handled internally.
requirements: v128 type must be available from wabt/common.h and properly constructed by the caller.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteChar
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteChar(char c, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Writes a single character (as unsigned byte) to the stream.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteMemoryDump
functions.signature: void wabt::Stream::WriteMemoryDump(const void* start, size_t size, size_t offset = 0, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No, const char* prefix = nullptr, const char* desc = nullptr)
functions.description: Writes a human-readable hex dump of a memory region (similar to xxd) to the stream. The dump can start at an internal offset into the provided memory, with optional ASCII printing, line prefix, and description.
requirements: start must point to at least size bytes of readable memory.
offset should be within [0, size]; behavior for offset > size is unspecified.
prefix and desc may be null.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::WriteU8Enum
functions.signature: template <typename T> void wabt::Stream::WriteU8Enum(T value, const char* desc = nullptr, wabt::PrintChars print_chars = wabt::PrintChars::No)
functions.description: Convenience template to write an enum-like value as an 8-bit integer to the stream (casts to uint32_t and then writes as U8).
requirements: value must convert to an 8-bit value (i.e., its underlying numeric value should be in [0, 255]); otherwise WriteU8 will assert.

functions.name: wabt::Stream::Flush
functions.description: Flushes buffered output, if any. The base implementation is a no-op; derived streams may override.

functions.name: wabt::OutputBuffer::WriteToFile
functions.description: Writes the contents of the buffer to the specified file path.
requirements: filename must reference a writable file path; filesystem errors will be reflected in the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::OutputBuffer::WriteToStdout
functions.description: Writes the contents of the buffer to standard output.
requirements: The process must have a valid, writable stdout; errors are reflected in the returned Result.

functions.name: wabt::OutputBuffer::clear
functions.description: Clears the buffer contents (data becomes empty).

functions.name: wabt::OutputBuffer::size
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes currently stored in the buffer.

functions.name: wabt::MemoryStream::MemoryStream
functions.description: Constructs a MemoryStream with an internal OutputBuffer, optionally attaching a log stream.
requirements: If a non-null log stream is provided, it must outlive this MemoryStream.

functions.name: wabt::MemoryStream::output_buffer
functions.description: Returns a reference to the internal OutputBuffer.
requirements: The MemoryStream must currently own an OutputBuffer (i.e., not yet released via ReleaseOutputBuffer).
The returned reference becomes invalid if the stream is moved or the buffer is later released.

functions.name: wabt::MemoryStream::ReleaseOutputBuffer
functions.description: Releases ownership of the internal OutputBuffer to the caller and clears the stream’s buffer pointer.
requirements: Caller assumes ownership of the returned OutputBuffer and is responsible for its lifetime.
After release, operations that require the buffer may fail or require reinitialization (implementation-defined).

functions.name: wabt::MemoryStream::Clear
functions.description: Clears the memory stream’s buffer and resets internal state as appropriate.

functions.name: wabt::MemoryStream::WriteToFile
functions.description: Writes the memory stream’s buffer to the specified file path.
requirements: filename must reference a writable file path; filesystem errors are reflected in the returned Result.
The stream must currently own a valid OutputBuffer.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::FileStream
functions.description: Opens/creates a file for output and constructs a FileStream bound to it, optionally attaching a log stream.
requirements: filename must reference a file path that can be opened for writing by the process.
If a non-null log stream is provided, it must outlive this FileStream.
Call is_open() to verify successful open before writing.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::~FileStream
functions.description: Destructor that flushes and closes the file if owned by the FileStream.
requirements: After destruction, the FILE* (if owned) is closed and must not be used by the caller.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::CreateStdout
functions.description: Factory that creates a FileStream bound to the process’s standard output.
requirements: Standard output must be available and writable.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::CreateStderr
functions.description: Factory that creates a FileStream bound to the process’s standard error.
requirements: Standard error must be available and writable.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::is_open
functions.description: Returns whether the FileStream currently has a valid underlying FILE* handle.

functions.name: wabt::FileStream::Flush
functions.description: Flushes the underlying file stream (fflush).
requirements: The FileStream must be open; otherwise flushing has no effect or fails per implementation.

functions.name: wabt::operator+=
functions.description: Appends the contents of y to the end of x. Provides a std::string += std::string_view overload for efficient concatenation without creating a temporary std::string.
requirements: x must be a valid std::string reference.
y must reference a valid character range for the duration of the call (it need not be null-terminated).
The function returns x after appending; callers may rely on reference semantics.

functions.name: wabt::operator+
functions.description: Returns a new std::string formed by concatenating x and y. Reserves combined size and appends both views to avoid intermediate allocations.
requirements: x and y must reference valid character ranges for the duration of the call (they need not be null-terminated).

functions.name: wabt::cat_concatenate
functions.description: Base-case helper for variadic concatenation: no-op when there are no more arguments to append.
requirements: s must be a valid std::string reference.

functions.name: wabt::cat_compute_size
functions.description: Base-case size helper for variadic concatenation: returns 0 when there are no arguments. Used to pre-reserve capacity.

functions.name: wabt::cat
functions.signature: template <typename... Ts> std::string wabt::cat(const Ts&... args)
functions.description: Concatenates any combination of std::string, std::string_view, and const char* into a single std::string. Precomputes total size with cat_compute_size(args...) to reserve capacity, then appends all arguments via cat_concatenate.
requirements: Each argument must be acceptable to both cat_compute_size (convertible to std::string_view) and cat_concatenate (appendable via std::string::operator+= or std::string += std::string_view).
Any const char* arguments must be non-null and null-terminated.
Any std::string_view arguments must reference valid memory for the duration of the call.

functions.name: wabt::GetTokenTypeName
functions.description: Returns a human-readable name for the given TokenType. Typically used for diagnostics, debugging, or error messages.
requirements: token_type may be any wabt::TokenType value; behavior for TokenType::Invalid or out-of-range enum values is not documented in this header (assumed to return some name or placeholder).

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeBare
functions.description: Checks whether the token type falls within the Bare token range.

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeString
functions.description: Checks whether the token type is a string-like token (i.e., has associated textual data).

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeType
functions.description: Checks whether the token type represents a value type token.

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeOpcode
functions.description: Checks whether the token type represents an opcode token.

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeLiteral
functions.description: Checks whether the token type represents a literal token.

functions.name: wabt::IsTokenTypeRefKind
functions.description: Checks whether the token type represents a reference-kind token.

functions.name: wabt::Token::Token
functions.description: Default-constructs a Token with token_type_ initialized to TokenType::Invalid. Primarily useful as a placeholder to be assigned later.
requirements: Do not call any payload accessors (text(), type(), opcode(), literal()) on a default-constructed token; they will assert since the type is Invalid.

functions.name: wabt::Token::token_type
functions.description: Returns the token's TokenType discriminator indicating which kind of token it is and which payload accessor (if any) is valid.

functions.name: wabt::Token::HasText
functions.description: Returns true if this token's type indicates it has textual payload accessible via text().

functions.name: wabt::Token::HasType
functions.description: Returns true if this token's type indicates it has a wabt::Type payload (either a value type or a ref kind).

functions.name: wabt::Token::HasOpcode
functions.description: Returns true if this token's type indicates it has an opcode payload accessible via opcode().

functions.name: wabt::Token::HasLiteral
functions.description: Returns true if this token's type indicates it has a literal payload accessible via literal().

functions.name: wabt::Token::text
functions.description: Returns the token's textual payload. Asserts if the token does not have text (i.e., HasText() is false).
requirements: Caller must ensure HasText() is true before calling, or an assertion will fail.
The underlying character data referenced by the stored std::string_view must remain valid for the duration of the Token's use.

functions.name: wabt::Token::type
functions.description: Returns the token's type payload. Asserts if the token does not carry a type (i.e., HasType() is false).
requirements: Caller must ensure HasType() is true before calling, or an assertion will fail.
